headline: The physical flagship C6 holonomy compiles into the 72-slot packet address as a->a+1 mod3 and b->1-b, with selector rho and probe slot p fixed. The scheduler permutation has order 6 and cycle profile 6^12; g^3 is pure deck parity.
hardware_read: one ternary increment plus one binary XOR; no lookup table; probe slot untouched
physical_boundary: Scheduler/address compiler only; no microscopic E8 unitary implementation is claimed.
